scope.survival_fixtures: normal HP/MP, current unmodified kits, fixed level1 B01 / level4 B05 / level8 B12 / level12 Boss. Not campaign reachability evidence. Boss phase fixtures instantiate individual phase.
scope.exposure_fixtures: HP reset each tick and player offense disabled; density/action/logic timing only, not survival evidence.
scope.driver: 200ms delayed visible warnings/projectile state; decisions every150ms; actual total input reaction200–350ms. Projectile velocities inferred exactly by harness. No future move data.
scope.timing: Headless logic tick only; excludes rendering, UI, audio, driver. Host shared with other jobs, not stable 60FPS certification.
scope.boss_seeds: Boss fixtures with same start/phase are deterministic; different seed repeats are not independent difficulty samples.
scope.zero_safe_sampled_directions: Local 0.75s straight-velocity candidates; failure does not establish zero real exits.
scope.initial_reachability: Initial helper conservatively uses earliest deadline for all markers. Its 54 zero-candidate records are rechecked in marker_timing_review.json with each marker own deadline: all have a route. Replay excludes simultaneous hazards/projectiles; normal damage-on sessions are separate evidence.

final_delta.behavior_delta: Only B17 human general_cut approach speed210; authored body speed64/charge820/tell1.25 remain. Runtime override applies only while closing to next move range.
final_delta.scope: B17-only final regression; preserves normal resources through both phases. Cadence uses HP reset and offense suppression only to measure complete move timing.
